notes.title: V29 - Housekeeping update
notes.notes:
[h2]V29 - Housekeeping update[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced flickering on menu items
[*] Flickering highlights and effects and certain expanding/contracting objects now properly do so in sync with a global variable so they feel smoother 
[*] Resolved the broken Steam Leaderboards button
[*] Resolved crash on exit on Mac
[*] Now fully working on Linux (sorry about that)
[*] Full Steamdeck support confirmed
[*] Proper Cloud saving Cross-Platform Win/Mac/Lin
[*] Updated store page and features where appropriate
[*] Changed share button to now copy message/score to clipboard so you can use it anywhere instead of opening up a direct link to Twitter
[*] Decreased install size
[*] Updated the Unity backend
[*] Migrating save files (copying not deleting so old one is still there if something goes wrong) from old versions to new save location to be consistent with all my games.
[*] Removed additional exit menu and videos. 
[*] Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues. 
[*] Probably other minor fixes I forgot (sorry)
[/list]

Hotfix 2025-03-16 V29 - Added proper Simplified Chinese Font for Linux systems

Thanks yall, let me know if I missed anything or you hit problems :)
adamvision <3

notes.notes:

[*] Added Bit Blaster, Orbt, and Diamo songs for each of the special characters
[*] When you're stationary with a time slow power-up, the growth of the ball will stop completely
[*] Early button presses after death will not be erroneously detected
[*] Power-up timers correctly reset when dying and restarting they now also disappear upon death

notes.title: Secrets of the developer who sold half a million videogames you ve never heard of on Steam
notes.notes:
In the space of a half-hour conversation, Adam Nickerson, aka Nickervision Studios, uses a variant of the phrase I don t know really how to make videogames at least half a dozen times. Yet he s managed to singlehandedly sell half a million copies of his games on PC.

You ve probably never heard of Bit Blaster XL, for example, but it s shifted 260,000 copies on Steam. He developed it solo, in just two weeks. Its follow-up, on course to be equally successful, was developed in 75 hours.

How did he do it? He figured out exactly how to get noticed on Steam during this time of seemingly ceaseless new releases – a time that has destroyed the hopes and dreams of many other small developers. (more…)

notes.title: 'Diamo XL' now available
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/715010/Diamo_XL/] [b]Diamo XL[/b] [/url] is now available on Steam for PC, Mac, Linux.

Survive the constant onslaught of obstacles by moving your character to all five zones within the Diamond. Collect points before the enemies smash them and keep moving to keep your multiplier high. Fill in the four triangles to complete the Diamond and get bonus points.

This is an 'XL' version of my unreleased mobile game 'Diamo'. I have added/changed a variety of things to make it more suitable for the Steam platform. I have been learning to make games in my free time and love making small-yet-solid arcade games with simple mechanics. [b]Please expect 'Diamo XL' to be a small, re-playable, arcade score-chaser game where the only basic goals are to constantly beat your previous score and unlock a handful of alternate player characters.[/b]

Thanks to the unexpected success of my previous Steam games [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/433950] [b]Bit Blaster XL[/b] [/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/615610/Orbt_XL/] [b]Orbt XL[/b] [/url]  I have been able to spend a lot more time learning more about game development and intend to release more bite sized arcade games like this as I also start to develop bigger and better projects. I really appreciate all the feedback and support the community has given me.

Thank you to everyone for the support of my small games, it has been life changing. Also [b]PLEASE[/b] if you enjoyed Diamo XL make sure to leave a brief Steam review for it if you can, as I have found it to be one of the most important tools for getting others to notice my games.

Thanks for the support!
Adam Nickerson
[url=www.nickervisionstudios.com] [b]Nickervision Studios[/b] [/url]
